page.layout: One block of text on a single printed page: heading PRÆFATIO at top centre, then a justified paragraph in italic and roman; below it a dedicatory line, the name RODOLPHVS HOSPINIANVS with Tigurinus, and a woodcut ornament. No margin notes.

l.i: ꝛ hanc historiam in suam tutelam, patrocinium ac defensionem suscipere
dignetur, Altera Dedicationis hujus causa est, quòd non solum in Mar-
chia, seu Ditione ac Dominio V. toto verbi diuini doctrina splendidissimè
lucet, eamq; magna animi fortitudine, magnoq; zelo ac singulari
studio Celsitudo V. defendit & propagat: quod si in eò perrexerit, DEVM omni-
potentem remuneratorem largissimum experietur, neque is Vestro studio,
laboribus & sanctis conatibus unquam deerit: apud cunctos autem Veri-
tatis Evangelicæ amantes æternam laudem & gloriam consequetur.

main_text.l: Tertia causa est, ut Historia hæc manifestum ac certum sit quasi deposi-
tum, testimonium & signum S. P. Q. Tigurini erga Celsitud. Vestram
summæ observantiæ, studij & amoris singularis. Quod reliquum est,
DEVM Opt. Max. ex animo oro rogóque, ut Celsitudini Vestræ in hac
vita contingat optata longævitas: in fide Christi perennis stabilitas: in
Imperio firma tranquillitas, in obitu felix immortalitas: in cœlis autem
expectata beatitas: per IESVM CHRISTVM Dominum ac Servatorem
nostrum unicum, ✠Amen. Tiguri Helvetiorum Metropoli 28. Octobris,

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (decorative heraldic-style emblem) below the dedication; no printed text. The first line of the paragraph carries a decorative initial mark. Some words in the dedication are uncertain due to the scan; the opening word "ꝛ" may be a printer's mark for "Ut" or similar.
